chunks: But those who are ignorant say: "Why does God not speak or show us a sign?" The same question had been asked by men before them, who were like them in their hearts. But to those who are firm in their faith We have shown Our signs already.
ai.seo_question: Why did the ignorant ask for God to speak directly to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the stagnation of the 'ignorant' (al-Jahilun) who, despite witnessing miracles, lacked the inner certainty (yaqin) to recognize divine truth, mirroring the fate of previous nations. It underscores the distinction between mere visual proof and the spiritual insight required for true belief, a theme central to the concept of Imamate where the Imam serves as the living sign. The repetition of 'like their saying' emphasizes the cyclical nature of doubt among those whose hearts are sealed by arrogance.
